method: Current base and research records deduplicated by record ID. Point-anchor membership in overlapping editorial rectangles; line routes excluded. Unknown dates are separate and cannot fill dated cells. Broad windows may overlap many cells without continuous presence. Population-known requires numeric population bounds and an associated sourced claim. Language coverage requires an explicit linguistics claim with supporting source. Rows and periods overlap and are not additive. Zero never implies human absence. Early peopling/habitability screen is editorial, not a new arrival chronology. Pending intake not counted as integrated.

items.title: Book-review citations and online/print-year confusion
items.reason: Kosiba 2022, Morgado 2021, Pérez-Miguel 2021 and Chase 2021 are book reviews. Substantive claims routed to originals where accessible. Lane/Marsh online 2023 issue 2024; Valdez/Bettcher online 2022 issue 2023.

items.title: louisiana/florida/nevada/montana inventories
items.reason: Survey counts and diagnostic periods require site-level catalogs, public locations and individual phase chronologies before creating further settlement dots. Survey publication dates do not date occupation.

items.title: montana historical affiliations
items.reason: Goshen/McKean and point traditions cannot automatically be mapped as Blackfeet, Crow, Kiowa or Athabaskan speech. Book-review citations do not substitute for excavation reports.

items.title: colonial census language and boundaries
items.reason: Nationality estimates are not language data. No historical boundary polygons or county extracts have been fabricated from this regional compilation.

items.title: Taos founding and battle
items.reason: Do not turn 1964 legendary battle/fire chronology into an established 1450 founding. Tribal construction estimate 1000–1450 and earlier valley cultivation are preserved separately.

items.title: Taos trade fairs
items.reason: Specific Apaches/Comanches, goods, annual schedules and Spanish/French links not admitted from report synthesis; direct source-specific chronology still required. A 2021 book review is not primary evidence for precontact Taos commerce.

items.title: Southwest population and language
items.reason: No absolute Taos, Pot Creek, Tijeras or San Marcos residents recovered in accessed sources. No room-to-people conversion, annual curves, ethnic census or inferred ancient language territory.

items.title: Nationwide warfare and climatic causation
items.reason: Only original-source-checked local conflict findings admitted. Cave 7 chronology, continental battle inventories, ENSO-caused individual attacks and eruption-driven warfare remain unverified here.

items.title: Regional Southwest synthesis
items.reason: Hohokam/Fremont coastal California regional summaries are not converted into invented settlements. Detailed site phases, census estimates and routes require additional original sources.
